title: 第14章 新的法术下第15章 法术模型
slug: 法师之上第366章五环法师
content_zh:
高德接过约姆递来黄皮纸，快速浏览其上的信息。
法术清单上共列出了五个0环法术：
【酸液飞溅】（咒法系，0环）
对目标发射一颗小酸球，初始最远距离25尺（约等于8.5米）。
你必须做一次成功的远程接触攻击才能击中目标，酸球会造成强酸伤害。
酸球的酸液会在数秒后消失。
【提升抗力】（防护系，0环）
将法力注入目标（目标可以是己身）以提升目标的法术抗力，从而减少所承受的法术伤害与法术影响，一次施法可持续一分钟。
【剑刃防护】（防护系，0环）
伸手在空中勾勒出一个防护印记，以令自身对武器攻击造成的钝击、穿刺和挥砍伤害具有抗性。
【冰冻射线】（塑能系，0环）
对目标发射一道冰冷的蓝白射线进行一次远程法术攻击，初始最远距离25尺。
若命中，目标将受到冷冻伤害，并且速度减缓。
【阅读魔法】（预言系，0环）
你可以解读物品：书、卷轴、武器等等上的用其它方式无法解读的魔法文字，这样的解读通常不会释放这些文字中包含的魔法。
此外，一旦曾经施放本法术并解读某段魔法文字，之后就可以理解同一段文字而不必再次求助于阅读魔法。
..........
“怎样？满意吗？”
高德强行按捺住激动的心情，面无表情地抬头。
满意，很满意！

怎么会不满意
约姆提供的法术清单中，不但有他最需要的杀伤力法术，而且还是两个。
但是，交易最重要的原则就是不要让人看出你对交易物的满意，不然等来的必然是坐地起价。
“有一两个法术还算可以，勉强符合我的需求，就是法术配方的数量少了些。”高德半褒半贬地回道。
“不少了，这五个法术要想全部掌握，对法师学徒来说至少也需要一两年时间了。”约姆嘟囔道。
高德就当没听到约姆的嘟囔，开门见山问道：“一份法术配方你准备要价多少？”
“3只小公鸡。”约姆伸出三根手指。
“太贵，一份法术配方我最多出1枚金币。”高德微微皱眉，直接将约姆的出价折了一半还不止。
“在官方法师协会，一份0环法术配方的均价可是6金。”约姆立刻是开口强调道。
“你都说了这是官方的价格，如果你的价格相比官方没有明显的优势，我又何必在你这购买法术配方，违反禁令不说，还冒着极大的风险，毕竟谁知道你卖我的法术配方是真是假？”
“2金10银，”约姆再度沉默了片刻，声音终于响起，“我是土生土长的霍根城本地人，人就在这里，跑不掉，所以至少在配方真实性这方面有一定的保障，远不是你随便找个人交易所能比拟的。”
高德目光看向一旁一直在看戏的皮埃尔。
皮埃尔也是个人精，点了点头道：“约姆他确实是霍根人，在霍根城生活了这么多年从未离开过。”
高德心中一动，如果皮埃尔不是骗他的话，那约姆手中配方的真实性确实是有一定的保障。
毕竟跑得了和尚跑不了庙，约姆不可能为了做一单不超过十枚西恩金币的生意，逃离自己的故乡。
content_en:
Gothe took the yellow paper from Yom and quickly browsed the information on it.
There are five 0-level spells listed on the spell list:
[Acid splash] (Conjuration system, level 0)
Launches a small acid ball at the target, with an initial maximum distance of 25 feet (approximately 8.5 meters).
You must make a successful ranged touch attack to hit the target, and the acid ball deals acid damage.
The Acid Ball's acid disappears after a few seconds.
[Increase resistance] (Protection system, 0 rings)
Inject mana into the target (the target can be oneself) to increase the target's spell resistance, thereby reducing the spell damage and spell effects suffered. A spell cast can last for one minute.
[Blade Protection] (Protection system, 0 rings)
Reach out and draw a protective mark in the air, making yourself resistant to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from weapon attacks.
[Freeze Ray] (Plastic Energy System, 0 Ring)
Launch a cold blue-white ray at the target to perform a long-range spell attack. The initial maximum distance is 25 feet.
On a hit, the target takes cold damage and is slowed.
[Reading Magic] (Prophecy, 0 rings)
You can decipher otherwise undecipherable magical writing on objects: books, scrolls, weapons, and so on, but such decoding usually does not release the magic contained in the writing.
Additionally, once you have cast this spell and read a piece of magical text, you can later understand the same piece of text without having to resort to reading magic again.
...........
"How is it? Are you satisfied?"
Gothe forcibly suppressed his excitement and raised his head expressionlessly.
Satisfied, very satisfied!
How could you be dissatisfied?
The spell list provided by Yom included not only the lethal spells he needed most, but also two.
However, the most important principle in trading is not to let others see that you are satisfied with the transaction, otherwise you will inevitably end up with a higher price.
"One or two spells are pretty good, barely meeting my needs, but the number of spell formulas is a little less." Gothe replied with half praise and half derogation.
"That's quite a lot. To master all these five spells, it will take at least a year or two for a mage apprentice." Yom muttered.
Gothe pretended not to hear Yom's muttering and asked straight to the point: "How much are you going to charge for a spell recipe?"
"Three little cocks." Yom held out three fingers.
"It's too expensive. I can only offer 1 gold coin for a spell recipe at most." Gothe frowned slightly and directly discounted Yom's bid by more than half.
"In the official Mage Association, the average price of a 0-level spell formula is 6 gold." Yom immediately emphasized.
"You said this is the official price. If your price has no obvious advantage over the official price, why should I buy the spell formula from you? Not only does it violate the ban, but it also takes great risks. After all, who knows whether the spell formula you sold me is true or false?"
"Two golds and ten silvers," Yom was silent again for a moment, and his voice finally sounded, "I am a native of Hogan City. I am here and can't escape, so at least there is a certain guarantee in terms of the authenticity of the formula, which is far beyond what you can compare with just finding someone to trade with."
Gothe looked at Pierre who had been watching the show.
Pierre was also a spirited person, and he nodded and said, "Yom is indeed from Hogan. He has lived in Hogan City for so many years and has never left."
Gothe's heart moved. If Pierre hadn't lied to him, the authenticity of the formula in Yom's hands would indeed be guaranteed to a certain extent.
After all, a monk who could run away could not run away from the temple. It was impossible for Yom to escape his hometown just to do a business worth no more than ten gold coins.
